title.en: Later Satavahanas: regional kingship in the Deccan
title.zh: 后期百乘王朝：德干的区域王权

location.label: Deccan plateau; representative point near the Satavahana site of Kanaganahalli

summary.en:
The Satavahanas were one of several powers that emerged after Mauryan rule fragmented. Their Deccan kingdom belonged to a political landscape shared with Shaka rulers and other regional dynasties. Its history helps replace the idea that the whole subcontinent passed from one empire to another.

Buddhist monuments and inscriptions preserve relationships among rulers, donors and religious communities. These sources do not describe a single state with unchanged boundaries. The northern Kushans and western Shaka rulers offer useful contemporary comparisons: connected trade and cultural worlds could coexist with political competition.
summary.zh:
孔雀王朝统治瓦解之后，百乘王朝成为兴起的区域政权之一。其德干王国与塞种统治者及其他王朝共享一个多中心的政治世界。它的历史帮助我们跳出整个次大陆由一个帝国接替另一个帝国的想象。

佛教建筑和铭文留下王室、捐献者与宗教群体之间关系的线索。这些材料并不表示国家疆界始终不变。北方贵霜与西部塞种政权是可供同时比较的对象：贸易和文化联系能够与政治竞争并存。

dateNote.en: c. 50–230 CE follows Harvard’s later Satavahana ruler sequence. This is an explicit later-dynasty political phase; earlier Satavahana origins are disputed and are not assigned an invented founding date here. The pin is a Deccan regional reference, not a permanent capital.
dateNote.zh: 约50—230年采用哈佛的后期百乘君主序列。这是明确的王朝后期政治阶段；更早起源存在争议，本条不虚构建国年份。点位是德干区域参照，不表示永久首都。

sources.title: South Asia, 1000 B.C.–1 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Describes emergence of the Satavahanas after Mauryan disintegration and their Deccan setting.

sources.title: Satavahana-Saka-Kushan Age

en: The Deccan had its own political sequence alongside northern dynasties.
Satavahana chronology is approximate and differs between surveys.
zh: 德干有与北方王朝并行的政治序列。
百乘年代为大致范围，不同研究的分期有别。

title.en: Pala: Buddhist courts in Bengal and Bihar
title.zh: 波罗王朝：孟加拉与比哈尔的佛教宫廷

location.label: Bihar and Bengal; representative point near Nalanda

summary.en:
Pala kings ruled in eastern South Asia while other dynasties competed for power elsewhere in the subcontinent. Their support for Buddhist institutions connected royal authority to teaching, worship and the production of images. Nalanda received patronage, and other monastic complexes formed part of this landscape.

Sculpture and manuscript traditions from eastern India circulated beyond an individual court. This makes the Pala story useful for comparing political succession with religious networks: the loss of a dynasty did not erase the institutions, artistic practices or communities associated with it.
summary.zh:
波罗诸王在南亚东部统治的同时，其他王朝也在次大陆各处争夺权力。王室支持佛教机构，将政治权威与教学、礼拜和造像联系起来。那烂陀得到资助，其他寺院群也构成这一文化景观。

东印度的雕塑与写本传统并不限于单一宫廷。波罗历史因而适合用来比较政治更替与宗教网络：王朝失去统治，并不等于相关机构、艺术实践或社区随之消失。

dateNote.en: Approximate Pala-period convention c. 750–1174 follows the McMullen Museum. Surveys differ over early consolidation and whether late local rulers belong to the imperial line; the Met uses a broader c. 700–1200 grouping. This is qualified political chronology, not Nalanda’s lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 约750—1174年采用麦克马伦博物馆的波罗时期分期。早期整合与晚期地方统治者是否属于帝国直系存在争议；大都会使用较宽的约700—1200年分组。这是有保留的政治年代，不是那烂陀寺的寿命。

sources.title: South Asia: North, 500–1000 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Describes Pala patronage of Nalanda and Vikramashila, with a broad dynastic period.

sources.title: Bengal under the Palas and Senas (750–1204)
sources.publisher: Pakistan Journal of History and Culture / NIHCR

en: Bengal and Bihar formed a major center of Buddhist patronage.
Dynastic dates and the lives of monasteries are different things.
zh: 孟加拉与比哈尔是佛教资助的重要中心。
王朝年代不同于寺院机构的存续年代。

title.en: Rashtrakuta: a Deccan power among regional rivals
title.zh: 罗湿陀罗拘陀王朝：区域竞争中的德干强权

summary.en:
Rashtrakuta rulers were a major power in the Deccan during the period of regional kingdoms after Gupta authority declined. Their political history belongs alongside the Palas and Gurjara-Pratiharas, rather than beneath a single north-Indian chronology.

The monumental complexes at Ellora preserve a setting in which Buddhist, Hindu and Jain construction unfolded over centuries. Connecting court history with these sites helps distinguish the succession of rulers from the longer careers of workshops, religious communities and building traditions. A political timeline is one layer of the landscape, not its entire history.
summary.zh:
笈多权威衰落后的区域王国时代，罗湿陀罗拘陀统治者是德干的重要力量。其历史应与波罗和瞿折罗—波罗提诃罗并列理解，而不是被埋在单一的北印度年表之下。

埃洛拉建筑群保存了佛教、印度教与耆那教建筑在数百年中发展的环境。把宫廷史与这些遗址相连，有助于区分君主的更替和工坊、宗教群体、建筑传统更长久的活动。政治年表只是景观的一层，并非其全部历史。

dateNote.en: Approximate dynasty c. 750–973 follows the Met. The representative point near Manyakheta does not imply a fixed territorial outline or that every Ellora monument belongs to this dynasty.
dateNote.zh: 王朝约750—973年的分期采用大都会博物馆。摩尼耶契吒附近点位不表示固定疆界，也不表示埃洛拉每一座建筑都属于该王朝。

sources.title: South Asia: North, 500–1000 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Dates Rashtrakuta rule c. 750–973 among concurrent regional dynasties.

sources.title: Ellora Caves
sources.evidenceNote: Describes the Buddhist, Hindu and Jain complex and its long building sequence.

en: The dynasty was based in the Deccan.
Ellora preserves several religious and chronological layers.
zh: 王朝以德干为政治基地。
埃洛拉保存多个宗教与年代层次。

title.en: Hoysala: temples as a language of regional kingship
title.zh: 曷萨拉王朝：寺庙与区域王权

summary.en:
Hoysala rulers established a regional kingdom in southern India whose monuments made political identity visible through architecture. Temples at Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura combine selected earlier and contemporary forms into a distinctive sculptural program.

Dense narrative carving, circumambulatory platforms and successive sculptural bands invite visitors to move around a building while reading its imagery. These monuments connect rulers to skilled designers, stone workers and worshippers. The kingdom can be compared with Chola and Kakatiya courts without treating southern India as a single dynasty or artistic tradition.
summary.zh:
曷萨拉统治者在印度南部建立区域王国，并通过建筑使政治身份可见。贝鲁尔、哈勒比德和索马纳塔普拉的寺庙选择、组合早期和同时代形式，形成自己的雕塑语言。

密集的叙事雕刻、绕行平台与层层雕塑带，引导参观者边行走边阅读图像。这些建筑把君主与设计者、石工和礼拜者联系起来。将它与朱罗和卡卡提亚宫廷比较，可以避免把南印度想象成单一王朝或艺术传统。

dateNote.en: Qualified dynastic convention 1026–1343; earlier chiefly origins and terminal successor politics yield other dates in surveys. The point marks Halebidu, not the kingdom’s entire extent. The cited UNESCO ensembles are principally twelfth–thirteenth century.
dateNote.zh: 1026—1343年为有保留的王朝分期；若计入更早酋长阶段或末期继承政治，研究会采用其他日期。点位标记哈勒比德，而不是全境。所引世界遗产建筑主要属于12—13世纪。

sources.title: Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas
sources.evidenceNote: Assesses the three temple complexes and deliberate differentiation from neighboring kingdoms.

sources.title: Corporeal Experience and the Material World of the Vijayanagara Sacred Landscape
sources.publisher: Candis L. Haak / University of Toronto doctoral dissertation (2018)
sources.evidenceNote: Author’s dissertation text and political chronology table use Hoysala kingdom 1026–1343 and identify Dvarasamudra; consulted via the author’s Academia-hosted full text.

en: Hoysala royal identity took visible form in temple design.
Its major surviving temple ensembles date mainly to the twelfth and thirteenth centuries.
zh: 曷萨拉王权身份通过寺庙设计表达。
主要现存建筑群多建于12—13世纪。

title.en: Kakatiya: reservoirs, temples and a Telugu-speaking court
title.zh: 卡卡提亚王朝：水库、寺庙与泰卢固地区宫廷

summary.en:
The Kakatiya kingdom provides another political sequence in the Deccan alongside the Hoysalas and Cholas. Its temple landscapes joined sacred architecture to cultivated land and engineered water storage. These relationships show how religious patronage depended on a wider working countryside.

At Palampet, construction of the Rudreshwara temple began in 1213. Carved pillars and bracket figures record regional dance imagery, while porous bricks reduced the roof’s weight. The nearby reservoir is part of the same historical setting. The surviving ensemble is evidence of practical engineering and specialized craft, as well as royal representation.
summary.zh:
卡卡提亚王国为德干补上一条与曷萨拉、朱罗并行的政治序列。其寺庙景观将圣所、农田和人工蓄水设施相连，显示宗教资助依赖更广阔的生产性乡村。

帕兰佩特的鲁德雷湿瓦拉寺于1213年开工。雕刻柱与托架人像表现区域舞蹈，轻质多孔砖则减轻屋顶重量。附近水库属于同一历史环境。现存建筑群既体现王权表达，也留下实用工程与专业技艺的证据。

dateNote.en: 1123–1323 follows UNESCO’s Kakatiya-period convention; some political histories include earlier subordinate rulers. Warangal is a representative center. The temple’s 1213 start is distinct from the dynasty’s start.
dateNote.zh: 1123—1323年采用联合国教科文组织的卡卡提亚时期分期；部分政治史计入更早的附属统治阶段。瓦朗加尔为代表性中心。寺庙1213年的开工时间不同于王朝起点。

sources.title: Kakatiya Rudreshwara (Ramappa) Temple
sources.evidenceNote: Gives the period 1123–1323, 1213 temple foundation, reservoir setting, construction materials and dance imagery.

en: Reservoirs and cultivated fields belong to the temple’s historical setting.
The dynasty’s dates must not be confused with a building’s construction dates.
zh: 水库和农田属于寺庙的历史环境。
王朝年代不能与单座建筑工期混为一谈。

title.en: Sikh kingdom: uniting power in the Punjab
title.zh: 锡克王国：旁遮普的政治整合

summary.en:
Under Ranjit Singh, a Sikh kingdom took shape in the Punjab at the turn of the nineteenth century. Lahore became the center of a state that joined territories and military resources previously divided among competing powers. Its history belongs beside Company expansion, not merely as a preface to British rule.

The kingdom’s political lifespan ended with annexation after the Anglo-Sikh wars, while Sikh communities and religious institutions continued. Studying this interval alongside Mughal decline and British expansion helps distinguish a regional political project from the much longer history of a religion and its people.
summary.zh:
19世纪之交，兰季特·辛格领导下的锡克王国在旁遮普成形。拉合尔成为政治中心，将先前由不同势力掌握的土地和军事资源整合起来。它应与东印度公司的扩张并列研究，而非仅作为英国统治的前奏。

英锡战争后的兼并终结了王国的政治存在，但锡克社区与宗教机构继续发展。把这一时期放在莫卧儿衰落和英国扩张之间，可以区分一个区域国家工程与宗教及民众更长久的历史。

dateNote.en: 1799–1849 follows the British Museum and the Cambridge dynastic chapter. Ranjit Singh’s capture of Lahore anchors the start; his royal coronation was later. The point is Lahore, not the kingdom’s changing borders.
dateNote.zh: 1799—1849年采用大英博物馆与剑桥王国史章节的分期。起点锚定兰季特·辛格占领拉合尔，其正式加冕在后。点位为拉合尔，不表示王国不断变化的边界。

sources.title: Sikh
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies the independent Punjab kingdom 1799–1849 under Ranjit Singh.

sources.title: The Sikh empire (1799–1849)
sources.publisher: J. S. Grewal / Cambridge University Press
sources.evidenceNote: Scholarly chapter defining the political interval.

en: The kingdom and Sikh religious history have different timescales.
The political center was Lahore.
zh: 王国与锡克宗教史具有不同时间尺度。
拉合尔是其政治中心。

title.en: Samanids: government and Persian culture at Bukhara
title.zh: 萨曼王朝：布哈拉的政务与波斯文化

summary.en:
Samanid rulers governed Transoxiana and Khurasan while acknowledging the Abbasid caliph’s authority. Their courts at Bukhara and Nishapur made the eastern Islamic lands a political and cultural center in their own right. Persian literary patronage developed alongside Arabic learning and Islamic institutions.

Government required more than a royal court: administrative writing, taxation and irrigation management linked cities to cultivated landscapes. The partition of Samanid power between Qarakhanids and Ghaznavids in 999 changed rulers without making those systems disappear. Later claimants and resistance explain why some histories extend the dynasty beyond that turning point.
summary.zh:
萨曼统治者在承认阿拔斯哈里发权威的同时治理河中与呼罗珊。布哈拉和内沙布尔宫廷，使伊斯兰世界东部成为具有自身地位的政治与文化中心。波斯文学资助与阿拉伯学问、伊斯兰机构并行发展。

治理不仅依靠王室宫廷：行政文书、税赋和灌溉管理把城市与农耕景观联系起来。999年，喀喇汗与伽色尼瓜分萨曼权力，并不意味着原有制度随之消失。此后的复兴尝试也解释了某些历史将王朝终点延后的原因。

dateNote.en: 819–999 represents the dynastic governorships through the loss of Bukhara and partition. A claimant resisted until 1005, so 999 is not the disappearance of every Samanid claimant. Bukhara is a representative court point.
dateNote.zh: 819—999年从王朝地方任命算起，至失去布哈拉及领地被瓜分。复兴者抵抗至1005年，因此999年不是所有萨曼王位主张者消失的时间。点位代表布哈拉宫廷。

sources.evidenceNote: Describes Samanid autonomous control and Persian cultural patronage.

sources.title: Khorasan in the Taherid and Samanid periods
sources.evidenceNote: Examines government, irrigation offices, documents and the end of Samanid control.

sources.title: Abd-al-Malek b. Nuh

en: The dynasty connected Bukhara and Khurasan to the Abbasid political world.
999 marks loss of the main state, not the end of Persian culture.
zh: 王朝把布哈拉与呼罗珊接入阿拔斯政治世界。
999年标记主要政权瓦解，不是波斯文化终结。

title.en: Ghaznavids: a court between Iran and South Asia
title.zh: 伽色尼王朝：伊朗与南亚之间的宫廷

summary.en:
The Ghaznavid dynasty grew from the power of Turkic military commanders on the Samanid frontier. From Ghazni its rulers built a kingdom linking eastern Iranian lands with Afghanistan and northwestern South Asia. Its territories changed through campaigns, competition and the rise of neighboring powers.

Persian court culture and literary patronage accompanied military expansion. The Seljuq victory at Dandanakan in 1040 removed much of the western realm; later rulers survived farther east, ultimately in the Punjab. The Ghurid capture of Lahore in 1186 ended the remaining dynasty. A single broad empire outline would hide this shifting political geography.
summary.zh:
伽色尼王朝兴起于萨曼边疆突厥军事统领的权力。统治者以伽色尼为基地，建立连接伊朗东部、阿富汗和南亚西北部的王国。领地随战争、竞争与邻国兴起而变化。

军事扩张伴随波斯宫廷文化和文学资助。1040年塞尔柱在丹丹干获胜，使其失去西部大部分领土；后继统治者在更东部、最终在旁遮普继续统治。1186年古尔攻占拉合尔，终结了余下王朝。用一张固定帝国轮廓无法表现这种变化。

dateNote.en: 977–1186 follows Bosworth’s dynastic definition. Ghazni is the early court reference; the final rulers were in Lahore. The interval does not assert unchanged control across the whole region.
dateNote.zh: 977—1186年采用博斯沃思的王朝定义。伽色尼是早期宫廷参照，末期统治者位于拉合尔。整个时段不表示对区域始终维持同样控制。

sources.title: Ghaznavids
sources.evidenceNote: Defines 977–1186 and explains the dynasty’s changing geography.

sources.title: Khorasan from the Ghaznavids to the Mongol conquest
sources.evidenceNote: Dates the loss of Khorasan and the final fall of Lahore.

en: The ruling house was Turkic while court patronage supported Persian culture.
Loss of western territories preceded the dynasty’s final end.
zh: 王室具有突厥背景，宫廷资助波斯文化。
西部领土丧失早于王朝最终终结。

title.en: Ghurids: a mountain dynasty becomes an imperial power
title.zh: 古尔王朝：山地王朝成为跨区域强权

location.label: Ghur region; representative point near the Minaret of Jam

summary.en:
The Ghurids began as chiefs in the mountains of central Afghanistan and became a major military power during the twelfth century. Their expansion reached from eastern Iranian lands toward northern India, competing with and displacing Ghaznavid rulers.

This was a short-lived imperial formation rather than an enduring state with one settled border. Persian literary and religious patronage linked its courts to the wider eastern Islamic world. Its collapse before the Mongol conquests and the emergence of successor military governments in South Asia show why political succession should be followed across regions, rather than stopping at a modern national border.
summary.zh:
古尔王朝起于阿富汗中部山地酋长，在12世纪成为重要军事力量。其扩张从伊朗东部伸向北印度，与伽色尼统治者竞争并取而代之。

这是一个短暂的帝国组合，并非拥有稳定边界的持久国家。波斯文学与宗教资助把其宫廷接入更广泛的东方伊斯兰世界。蒙古征服之前的瓦解，以及南亚继承性军事政权的兴起，都说明政治更替需要跨区域追踪，而不能在现代国界处停止。

dateNote.en: Approximate c. 1150–1215 represents the mid-twelfth-century major-power phase, not the beginning of the local family. Earlier chiefly origins are excluded. Jam is a regional reference; several courts and campaign centers were involved.
dateNote.zh: 约1150—1215年表示12世纪中叶开始的强权阶段，不是地方家族起点。更早酋长阶段未计入。贾姆为区域参照，实际涉及多个宫廷与军事中心。

sources.title: Ghurids
sources.evidenceNote: Explains mountain origins, mid-twelfth-century expansion, Persian literature and demise by 1215.

sources.title: Minaret and Archaeological Remains of Jam
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies Jam’s Ghurid historical context and late-twelfth-century monument.

en: A local mountain dynasty became a power spanning several regions.
The chosen interval represents its imperial phase.
zh: 地方山地王朝成为横跨多个区域的强权。
所选时段代表其帝国阶段。

title.en: Qarakhanids: Turkic Muslim courts across Central Asia
title.zh: 喀喇汗王朝：中亚的突厥穆斯林宫廷

summary.en:
Qarakhanid rulers connected the Tarim Basin and Transoxiana within a Turkic Muslim political world. Their origins and internal history are difficult to reconstruct because few narrative works written within the dynasty survive. Coins, inscriptions and outside accounts therefore carry unusual importance.

In 999 they took Bukhara as the Samanid dominions were divided with the Ghaznavids. Later eastern and western branches had different political histories, including subordination to stronger neighbors. This entry treats them as a related dynastic sequence, not one centralized kingdom whose borders remained the same throughout.
summary.zh:
喀喇汗统治者把塔里木盆地与河中地区连接在一个突厥穆斯林政治世界中。由于王朝内部撰写的叙事著作少有存世，其起源和内部历史难以完整重建。钱币、铭文和外部记载因此尤其重要。

999年，他们取得布哈拉，并与伽色尼瓜分萨曼领地。此后东西支系经历不同政治进程，包括臣属于更强邻国。本条目将其视为有关联的王朝序列，而不是疆界始终相同的单一中央集权国家。

dateNote.en: Approximate c. 950–1212 uses the mid-tenth-century emergence of the Muslim dynasty through the western branch’s end. Earlier clan origins and the eastern branch have different dates. Samarkand is one representative center.
dateNote.zh: 约950—1212年，从10世纪中叶穆斯林王朝兴起至西支终结。更早部族起源与东支终点另有年代。撒马尔罕只是代表性中心之一。

sources.title: Qarakhanid
sources.evidenceNote: Defines the dynasty’s mid/late-tenth to early-thirteenth-century span and documents source limitations and branches.

en: Internal narrative sources survive unevenly.
Eastern and western branches did not share one political trajectory.
zh: 内部叙事材料保存不均。
东西支系不具有完全相同的政治轨迹。

title.en: Golden Horde: a Mongol successor state across the steppe
title.zh: 金帐汗国：草原上的蒙古继承国家

summary.en:
After the Mongol conquests, the dynasty descended from Jochi ruled the western steppe and exercised power over neighboring principalities. The Golden Horde was one of several Mongol successor states, alongside the Chagatai realm, the Ilkhanids and the Yuan. They shared ancestry without functioning as a single unchanging administration.

Its cities and courts participated in commerce, diplomacy and artistic exchange across Eurasia. Political fragmentation produced successor khanates over time, so the final date of the Great Horde should not be read as the disappearance of every related state. Comparison with the Ilkhanids reveals both connections and rivalry within the post-conquest world.
summary.zh:
蒙古征服之后，术赤后裔统治西部草原，并对邻近公国行使权力。金帐汗国与察合台、伊儿汗、元朝同属蒙古继承国家。共同祖源并不意味着它们始终属于一个不变的行政体系。

其城市与宫廷参与横跨欧亚的贸易、外交和艺术交流。政治分裂逐渐产生继承汗国，因此大帐末期的终点不能被理解为所有相关国家同时消失。与伊儿汗国比较，可以看见征服后世界内部的联系与竞争。

dateNote.en: 1227–1502 follows the Met’s broad dynastic convention, ending with the Great Horde; the western conquests and fragmentation occurred within that span. The Sarai-area point is approximate and does not fix a single capital for all years.
dateNote.zh: 1227—1502年采用大都会博物馆宽泛王朝分期，以大帐终结为末端；西征与分裂发生于其间。萨莱区域点位为大致参照，不表示每年都以同一地点为都。

sources.title: The Legacy of Genghis Khan
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies the Mongol successor states and dates Golden Horde c. 1227–1502.

sources.title: Golden Horde
sources.evidenceNote: Scholarly history of the Jochid western realm, political geography and fragmentation.

en: Shared Mongol ancestry did not make all successor states one government.
Successor khanates outlasted the fragmentation of the main realm.
zh: 共同蒙古祖源并不等于同一政府。
部分继承汗国在主体分裂后继续存在。

title.en: Qajar: royal revival and changing public images
title.zh: 卡扎尔王朝：王权复古与公共形象变化

summary.en:
Qajar rulers made Tehran the center of a new Iranian dynasty. Their public imagery drew on older royal traditions while using new forms of representation. Monumental portraits and references to ancient kingship linked the court to an imagined historical continuity.

Nineteenth-century painting also responded to photography, European techniques and new subjects. These changes were not a simple replacement of local practice by foreign influence: revival and innovation occurred together. Constitutional change in the early twentieth century further altered the relationship between monarchy, government and public life before the dynasty ended.
summary.zh:
卡扎尔统治者以德黑兰为中心建立新的伊朗王朝。其公共形象援引旧有王权传统，同时采用新的表现形式。大型肖像与古代君权意象，将宫廷接入想象中的历史连续性。

19世纪绘画也回应摄影、欧洲技法与新题材。这并非外来影响简单替代本土实践，而是复古与创新同时发生。20世纪初的立宪变化进一步改变君主、政府和公共生活的关系，随后王朝终结。

dateNote.en: 1786–1925 follows Amanat’s Qajar-period convention; other art surveys use 1779–1924. The interval includes initial consolidation and later constitutional monarchy, not a single unchanged regime. Tehran is a representative capital.
dateNote.zh: 1786—1925年采用阿马纳特的卡扎尔时期分期，其他艺术史调查使用1779—1924年。时段包含早期整合与后来的立宪君主制，并非同一不变政体。德黑兰为代表性首都。

sources.title: Nineteenth-Century Iran: Continuity and Revivalism
sources.evidenceNote: Examines old royal references and newer media; uses an explicitly different art-period convention.

sources.title: Nineteenth-Century Iran: Art and the Advent of Modernity
sources.evidenceNote: Discusses photography, naturalism and changing painting.

sources.title: Historiography: Qajar period
sources.evidenceNote: Abbas Amanat explicitly uses 1786–1925 and examines changing court and constitutional historical writing.

sources.title: Ahmad Shah Qajar
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies the last ruler and deposition in 1925.

en: Revival and new media coexisted at the Qajar court.
Art-period conventions differ from exact political endpoints.
zh: 复古与新媒介在卡扎尔宫廷并存。
艺术时期分期不同于政治终点。

title.en: Merovingians: Frankish kingdoms after Roman Gaul
title.zh: 墨洛温王朝：罗马高卢之后的法兰克诸王国

location.label: Paris region; representative Frankish royal center

summary.en:
Merovingian kings ruled Frankish kingdoms that emerged from the former Roman province of Gaul. Political change did not remove Roman practices overnight: administration, Latin learning and artistic techniques continued in changing forms. Royal conversion and aristocratic patronage strengthened Christian institutions.

Monasteries and churches became centers of learning, wealth and authority. The networks built in this period later supported Carolingian government. Divisions among rulers mean that a single dynastic bar should not be mistaken for one continuously united territory. This entry supplies the political context behind the later story of Charlemagne.
summary.zh:
墨洛温诸王统治从罗马高卢演变而来的法兰克王国。政治更替并未一夜抹去罗马实践：行政、拉丁学问和艺术技法以变化的形式继续存在。王室改宗与贵族资助增强了基督教机构。

修道院和教堂成为知识、财富与权威中心。这一时期形成的网络后来支撑加洛林治理。由于统治者之间反复分割，单一王朝时间条不能被误读为疆域始终统一。本条目为后来的查理曼历史补上政治背景。

dateNote.en: 482–751 follows the Met chronology, anchored to Clovis’s reign and the replacement of the last Merovingian king. Earlier family origins are excluded; the kingdoms were divided and reunited within this span.
dateNote.zh: 482—751年采用大都会博物馆年表，以克洛维统治和最后一位墨洛温君主被取代为锚。未计入更早家族起源；其间诸王国经历分割与重组。

sources.title: France, 500–1000 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Dates Merovingian rule 482–751 and explains Roman continuities, conversion and monasteries.

en: Roman practices continued through political change.
The dynasty ruled several divided and reunited kingdoms.
zh: 罗马实践在政治变化中继续存在。
王朝统治经历分合的多个王国。

title.en: Carolingians: royal power, learning and partition
title.zh: 加洛林王朝：王权、学问与分割

summary.en:
The Carolingians replaced the Merovingian royal house and expanded Frankish power. Charlemagne’s imperial coronation in Rome in 800 connected rulership to Christian Roman authority. His court gathered scholars and promoted book production and learning.

The kingdom and empire were subsequently divided among heirs. Workshops and monasteries continued to produce manuscripts, ivory carving and metalwork under several courts. The dynasty’s long survival in the western kingdom therefore differs from the shorter history of a united empire. The timeline records dynastic succession, while the linked coronation entry isolates one decisive event.
summary.zh:
加洛林家族取代墨洛温王室并扩展法兰克权力。800年查理曼在罗马获皇帝加冕，将统治与基督教罗马权威相连。其宫廷聚集学者，并推动书籍制作与学习。

王国与帝国后来在继承者之间分割。工坊和修道院在多个宫廷支持下，继续制作写本、象牙雕刻与金属器。因此王朝在西部王国的长期延续，不同于统一帝国较短的历史。时间线记录王朝更替，相关加冕条目则聚焦一项关键事件。

dateNote.en: 751–987 follows the western Frankish dynastic sequence, not a united empire lasting to 987. The imperial title began in 800 and partitions changed authority earlier. Aachen is one representative royal center.
dateNote.zh: 751—987年采用西法兰克王朝序列，不表示统一帝国延续至987年。皇帝称号始于800年，权力在此前后历经分割。亚琛仅为代表性王室中心。

sources.title: Carolingian Art
sources.evidenceNote: Connects coronation, classical learning, court scholars and artistic production.

sources.title: France, 500–1000 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Gives western dynastic dates 751–987.

en: An imperial coronation was not the beginning of the dynasty.
Dynastic survival outlasted political unity.
zh: 皇帝加冕并非王朝起点。
王朝延续长于政治统一。

title.en: Ottonians: kings and an imperial revival
title.zh: 奥托王朝：诸王与帝号复兴

summary.en:
A Saxon royal family established a new ruling dynasty in the eastern Frankish world. Otto I became king in 936 and received the imperial title in 962. These steps renewed an imperial claim without simply restoring Charlemagne’s empire in its former shape.

Rulers, bishops and monasteries sponsored churches, manuscripts and luxury objects. Works at Magdeburg, Hildesheim and other centers combined Christian subjects with forms referring to earlier imperial authority. Royal succession and artistic patronage thus connect political history with the practical institutions that copied books, trained specialists and maintained church wealth.
summary.zh:
萨克森王室在东法兰克世界建立新的统治王朝。奥托一世于936年为王，962年获皇帝称号。这些步骤更新了帝国主张，但并非简单恢复查理曼帝国原貌。

君主、主教与修道院资助教堂、写本和珍贵器物。马格德堡、希尔德斯海姆等中心的作品，将基督教题材与指向早期帝权的形式结合。王位继承与艺术资助由此接入抄书、培养专业人员及管理教会财富的实际机构。

dateNote.en: 919–1024 includes Henry I’s kingship before Otto I; the Met art chronology often starts at Otto’s 936 coronation. Imperial rule starts in 962. Magdeburg is a representative patronage center, not a constant capital.
dateNote.zh: 919—1024年计入奥托一世之前亨利一世的王位；大都会艺术分期常从936年奥托加冕算起。帝号始于962年。马格德堡为代表性资助中心，不表示固定首都。

sources.title: Ottonian Art
sources.evidenceNote: Explains Otto I’s 936 and 962 coronations, church patronage and imperial references.

sources.title: The dynastic changes of 751 and 919 in contemporary sources
sources.evidenceNote: Scholarly source study identifies the 919 dynastic transition.

en: Royal and imperial titles began at different moments.
Monasteries and bishops were central to artistic patronage.
zh: 王位与帝号在不同时间开始。
修道院与主教是艺术资助的重要力量。

title.en: Capetians: assembling royal power in France
title.zh: 卡佩王朝：法国王权的逐步整合

summary.en:
Capetian kings began with authority contested by powerful regional lords. Across the following centuries, royal government expanded its reach within the kingdom of France. The history involves negotiation, warfare and institutions rather than the sudden appearance of a fully formed modern nation.

Royal religious patronage and the rebuilding of churches helped express authority. The Met’s chronology highlights Philip II, Louis IX and Philip IV as rulers associated with this expansion. The direct Capetian line ended in 1328, while the Valois branch continued a related royal lineage. A dynastic change therefore need not mark the end of the kingdom.
summary.zh:
卡佩诸王起初的权威受到强大地方领主限制。随后数百年，王室政府逐渐扩大在法兰西王国内的影响。这段历史涉及协商、战争和制度建设，而不是一个完整现代民族国家突然出现。

王室宗教资助与教堂重建帮助表达权威。大都会年表特别强调腓力二世、路易九世和腓力四世与王权扩展的关系。卡佩直系于1328年终结，瓦卢瓦支系继续同一家族谱系。因此王朝支系更替并不一定意味着王国灭亡。

dateNote.en: 987–1328 represents the direct Capetian royal line; cadet branches ruled later. Paris is a representative center, not the extent of royal control in every year.
dateNote.zh: 987—1328年指卡佩直系王朝，其旁支此后继续统治。巴黎为代表性中心，不表示王室在每一年控制的全部范围。

sources.title: France, 1000–1400 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Provides direct dynastic dates, regional lords and growth of royal authority.

en: The kingdom and the direct royal line have different endpoints.
Royal authority grew within a landscape of powerful regional lords.
zh: 王国与王室直系具有不同终点。
王权在强大地方领主并存的环境中成长。

title.en: Dutch Republic: provinces, commerce and empire
title.zh: 荷兰共和国：诸省、贸易与帝国

location.label: The Hague; representative States General center

summary.en:
The northern Netherlands broke with the Spanish king during a long revolt. The 1581 Act of Abjuration rejected Philip II’s sovereignty; the republic’s institutions took shape through further political and military struggle. Recognition in 1648 was a later stage, not the beginning of every republican institution.

Cities, merchants and provincial governments participated in a state whose overseas companies joined commerce to coercive power. Domestic artistic markets grew alongside global connections. Reading this history with Batavia’s founding helps connect paintings and urban prosperity to conquest and colonial violence abroad.
summary.zh:
尼德兰北部在长期反抗中脱离西班牙国王。1581年的《断绝法案》拒绝腓力二世主权；共和国制度在后续政治与军事斗争中形成。1648年的承认是另一阶段，并非所有共和机构的起点。

城市、商人与省政府共同参与国家运作，海外公司则把贸易与强制权力结合。国内艺术市场与全球联系一同发展。将其与巴达维亚建立的历史一起阅读，可以把绘画与城市财富联系到海外征服及殖民暴力。

dateNote.en: 1581–1795 uses abjuration through replacement by the Batavian Republic. Some surveys start the republic in 1588; international recognition followed in 1648. The Hague is a representative governmental point.
dateNote.zh: 1581—1795年从断绝与西班牙国王关系算起，至巴达维亚共和国取代旧政体。部分研究以1588年为共和起点，国际承认在1648年。海牙为代表性政府点位。

sources.publisher: Helmer Helmers / British Academy — Oxford University Press
sources.evidenceNote: Examines 1581 Act of Abjuration and the republic’s institutional emergence.

sources.title: In Praise of Painting: exhibition guide
sources.evidenceNote: Connects Dutch painting to independence and the seventeenth-century republic.

sources.title: Batavia’s Company capital
sources.evidenceNote: Regional chronology of Dutch colonial power in Southeast Asia.

sources.title: Popular celebrations marking the Batavian Revolution, 1795
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional record of a drawing of the 1795 political transition.

en: Abjuration, republican consolidation and recognition were separate stages.
Overseas commerce was bound to colonial power.
zh: 断绝君主关系、共和整合与国际承认是不同阶段。
海外贸易与殖民权力相连。

title.en: Nasrids: Granada between diplomacy and conquest
title.zh: 纳斯里德王朝：外交与征服之间的格拉纳达

summary.en:
Nasrid rulers governed the last enduring Muslim kingdom in the Iberian Peninsula. Granada survived in a precarious political setting through diplomacy, alliances and conflict with neighboring powers. Its court attracted scholars and writers while supporting an extensive artistic world.

The Alhambra joined palaces, gardens and inscriptions into an environment representing royal authority. Nasrid workshops also produced textiles, ceramics and other luxury objects. The conquest of 1492 ended the dynasty, but its buildings and forms were reused by later rulers. Political defeat did not erase the material and cultural history of al-Andalus.
summary.zh:
纳斯里德统治者治理伊比利亚半岛最后一个长期存在的穆斯林王国。格拉纳达在脆弱的政治环境中，通过外交、结盟及与邻国冲突维持生存。宫廷吸引学者和作家，并支持广泛艺术生产。

阿尔罕布拉把宫殿、花园和铭文结合为表达王权的环境。纳斯里德工坊也制作织物、陶器及其他贵重物品。1492年的征服终结了王朝，但建筑与形式被后来统治者继续使用。政治失败没有抹去安达卢斯的物质文化史。

dateNote.en: 1232–1492 follows the Met’s dynastic convention. The point is Granada, not all places once governed by Nasrid rulers. Cultural continuities after conquest are not represented as continued Nasrid sovereignty.
dateNote.zh: 1232—1492年采用大都会博物馆的王朝分期。点位为格拉纳达，而非纳斯里德曾治理的所有地区。征服后的文化延续不等于王朝主权延续。

sources.title: The Art of the Nasrid Period (1232–1492)
sources.evidenceNote: Describes the dynastic dates, Granada’s precarious politics and court arts.

sources.title: Nasrid Rule in Spain
sources.evidenceNote: Explains continued use of the Alhambra and Andalusian forms after 1492.

en: The Alhambra expressed political authority through designed space.
1492 ended the dynasty, not every Andalusian artistic practice.
zh: 阿尔罕布拉通过空间设计表达政治权威。
1492年终结王朝，而非所有安达卢斯艺术实践。

title.en: Makuria: a Christian kingdom along the middle Nile
title.zh: 马库里亚：尼罗河中游的基督教王国

location.label: Tungul / Old Dongola; representative royal center

summary.en:
Makuria was a medieval Nubian kingdom with its capital at Tungul, now Old Dongola. Christianity reshaped its religious buildings, burial customs and writing traditions from the sixth century. Nile agriculture and exchange supported towns, monasteries and specialist crafts.

Relations with Egypt involved military resistance, negotiated agreements and controlled trade. The kingdom was connected to Mediterranean Christian worlds while developing local Nubian forms. Its later fragmentation was a process, not one securely dated collapse of every community. Looking at Makuria alongside Aksum and Fatimid Egypt restores a regional political history often missing between ancient Kush and the modern period.
summary.zh:
马库里亚是中世纪努比亚王国，以通古勒、即今旧栋古拉为都。6世纪起，基督教重塑宗教建筑、丧葬与书写传统。尼罗河农业和交换支撑城镇、修道院与专业手工业。

它与埃及的关系涉及军事抵抗、协商协议和贸易管理。王国与地中海基督教世界相连，同时发展本地努比亚形式。后期分裂是一个过程，不能用一个确切年份概括所有社区的终结。将马库里亚与阿克苏姆及法蒂玛埃及并列，可以补上古代库施和近代之间常被忽略的政治史。

dateNote.en: Approximate c. 550–1400 follows the archaeological project’s fifth/sixth–fourteenth-century Makurian period, rounded to annual display. Christianization, contraction and royal fragmentation had different dates. This is a qualified dynastic-period convention, not the end of Nubian peoples or Christianity.
dateNote.zh: 约550—1400年依据考古项目5／6世纪至14世纪的马库里亚时期分期，并取整供年度显示。改宗、收缩和王室分裂并非同一时间。这是有保留的政治时期分期，不表示努比亚民族或基督教结束。

sources.title: Historical city travel guide: Kulubnarti, Sudan, late 12th century
sources.evidenceNote: Curator account of Makuria, Tungul, Christianity, Nile economy and relations with Egypt.

sources.title: Dongola archaeological project
sources.publisher: Polish Centre of Mediterranean Archaeology, University of Warsaw
sources.evidenceNote: Project summary dates the Makurian phase fifth/sixth–fourteenth century; indexed text reviewed, full page presented a captcha.

en: Tungul / Old Dongola was a major royal and religious center.
Political fragmentation did not end Nubian community history.
zh: 通古勒、即旧栋古拉是重要王室与宗教中心。
政治分裂没有终结努比亚社区历史。

title.en: Almoravids: linking the Sahara, Morocco and al-Andalus
title.zh: 穆拉比特王朝：连接撒哈拉、摩洛哥与安达卢斯

summary.en:
The Almoravid movement developed in the western Saharan world and established a ruling dynasty in Morocco. Marrakesh became its political center. Expansion linked Saharan routes with ports and cities on both sides of the western Mediterranean.

The dynasty entered al-Andalus after Christian forces took Toledo and assumed control of its Muslim kingdoms. Religious reform did not prevent participation in sophisticated textile and architectural production. This cross-strait history belongs to both North Africa and Iberia; a modern continental division should not divide the political sequence into unrelated stories.
summary.zh:
穆拉比特运动发端于撒哈拉西部，并在摩洛哥建立统治王朝。马拉喀什成为政治中心。扩张把撒哈拉商路与西地中海两岸的港口和城市联系起来。

基督教军队取得托莱多后，该王朝进入安达卢斯并控制当地穆斯林王国。宗教改革并未妨碍精细织物与建筑生产。跨海峡历史同时属于北非与伊比利亚；现代大陆划分不应把同一政治序列割成互不相关的故事。

dateNote.en: 1040–1147 is a broad movement-to-dynasty political convention. The Met art essay uses c. 1062–1150, with a narrower focus on Marrakesh and later artistic production; these conventions are not exact border dates.
dateNote.zh: 1040—1147年为从运动兴起至王朝终结的宽泛政治分期。大都会艺术史文章采用约1062—1150年，较集中于马拉喀什与后续艺术生产；这些分期不是精确疆界年代。

sources.title: The Art of the Almoravid and Almohad Periods
sources.evidenceNote: Explains Marrakesh, al-Andalus expansion and trans-Saharan exchange.

sources.title: Medina of Marrakesh
sources.evidenceNote: Describes Almoravid foundation and succeeding dynastic importance of Marrakesh.

sources.title: Almoravid empire — Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional historical-place record dates the empire 1040–1147.

en: The state crossed the western Mediterranean.
Religious reform and luxury production could coexist.
zh: 政权跨越西地中海两岸。
宗教改革与精细工艺生产能够并存。

title.en: Almohads: reform and empire in the western Mediterranean
title.zh: 穆瓦希德王朝：西地中海的改革与帝国

summary.en:
The Almohads displaced Almoravid power and built an empire linking the Maghreb with al-Andalus. Their movement combined religious claims with military and political organization. Marrakesh remained a central court, while other cities acquired new monumental buildings.

Large mosques and minarets made authority visible in urban space. The loss of Iberian power and later fragmentation did not happen simultaneously throughout the realm. Successor dynasties emerged in North Africa as the main ruling house weakened. The sequence connects Morocco’s cities to the later Nasrid kingdom at Granada without suggesting one continuous undivided state.
summary.zh:
穆瓦希德取代穆拉比特权力，建立连接马格里布与安达卢斯的帝国。其运动将宗教主张与军事、政治组织结合。马拉喀什仍是核心宫廷，其他城市也出现新的纪念性建筑。

大型清真寺和宣礼塔使权威在城市空间中可见。伊比利亚领土丧失与后期分裂，并非在全境同时发生。主体王室衰落时，北非出现继承王朝。这条序列把摩洛哥城市与后来的格拉纳达纳斯里德王国相连，但不表示两者属于一直统一的国家。

dateNote.en: 1130–1269 follows a broad political convention beginning with Abd al-Mu’min’s leadership, rather than the movement’s earliest preaching. Losses in al-Andalus occurred earlier than the dynasty’s final defeat at Marrakesh.
dateNote.zh: 1130—1269年采用从阿卜杜勒·穆敏领导阶段开始的宽泛政治分期，而非运动最早传教年代。安达卢斯失地早于王朝在马拉喀什最终失败。

sources.title: The Art of the Almoravid and Almohad Periods

sources.title: Almohad — Art and Architecture Thesaurus
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional authority record gives 1130–1269 for the North African and Iberian dynasty.

en: The empire connected North African and Iberian cities.
The loss of different regions occurred at different dates.
zh: 帝国连接北非与伊比利亚城市。
各地区失去的时间并不相同。

title.en: Dahomey: royal compounds and a changing Atlantic world
title.zh: 达荷美王国：王宫建筑与变化的大西洋世界

summary.en:
Dahomey developed around Abomey, where successive rulers built royal compounds. Palaces and their reliefs preserve claims about succession, warfare and the responsibilities of kingship. Their imagery was part of how royal history was communicated and remembered.

The kingdom belonged to the political and commercial world of the Atlantic coast, including warfare and the trafficking of enslaved people. French conquest ended independent royal power in the 1890s, while palace traditions and community memories continued. Royal heritage must therefore be read alongside the experiences of people subjected to coercion, rather than only as a record of court achievement.
summary.zh:
达荷美以阿波美为中心发展，历代统治者修建自己的王宫院落。宫殿与浮雕保存关于继承、战争和君主责任的表达。这些图像参与传达和记忆王室历史。

王国属于大西洋沿岸政治与贸易世界，其间涉及战争和被奴役人口贩运。19世纪90年代法国征服终结独立王权，但宫廷传统与社区记忆仍延续。因此王室遗产必须与遭受强制者的经历一同阅读，而不能只呈现为宫廷成就记录。

dateNote.en: 1625–1894 is a qualified independent-kingdom interval; UNESCO’s palace succession runs to 1900 and must not be mistaken for sovereignty lasting to that date. The 1890s conquest and later dynastic continuity are distinct.
dateNote.zh: 1625—1894年为有保留的独立王国时段；联合国教科文组织的王宫君主继承表延至1900年，不能被误读为主权一直延续到该年。19世纪90年代征服与后来王室延续需要区分。

sources.evidenceNote: Describes successive royal compounds, reliefs and royal succession 1625–1900.

sources.evidenceNote: Explains the royal heritage in historical context.

en: Royal succession can continue after independent sovereignty ends.
Palace art communicates claims about power and history.
zh: 独立主权终结后仍可能有王室继承。
王宫艺术传达关于权力与历史的主张。

title.en: Ayyubids: a family of courts from Egypt to Syria
title.zh: 阿尤布王朝：从埃及到叙利亚的家族宫廷

summary.en:
Salah al-Din ended the Fatimid caliphate in Egypt in 1171 and established Ayyubid rule. His dynasty extended power into Yemen and Syria. Its territories were administered through related rulers and courts rather than one uniformly centralized state.

Religious education, fortifications and skilled metalwork formed part of this political world. Objects and craftsmen moved between cities, crossing the boundaries of rival rulers. The rise of the Mamluks ended independent Ayyubid rule in Egypt in 1250, while Syrian strongholds survived longer. This overlapping succession explains why a single “dynasty ended” date needs a location qualification.
summary.zh:
萨拉丁于1171年结束埃及法蒂玛哈里发统治，建立阿尤布政权。其王朝把权力伸向也门与叙利亚。领地通过有亲缘关系的统治者和多个宫廷治理，并非处处具有同样中央集权。

宗教教育、城防和精细金属工艺属于这一政治世界。物品与工匠在城市之间流动，跨越竞争统治者的边界。1250年马穆鲁克兴起，终结阿尤布在埃及的独立统治，但叙利亚据点继续存在一段时间。因此单一“王朝结束”日期需要地点限定。

dateNote.en: 1171–1260 follows the Met’s broad dynastic period. Egypt’s independent Ayyubid line ended in 1250; Syrian strongholds had another trajectory. Cairo is a representative early center, not the court of every ruler.
dateNote.zh: 1171—1260年采用大都会博物馆的宽泛王朝时期。埃及独立支系于1250年终结，叙利亚据点另有进程。开罗是代表性早期中心，不表示每位统治者的宫廷。

sources.evidenceNote: Explains Salah al-Din’s rise, Egypt-Syria chronology and urban artistic connections.

sources.title: The Art of the Mamluk Period
sources.evidenceNote: Distinguishes Egypt’s 1250 transition from later Syrian succession.

en: Ayyubid courts were distributed among related rulers.
Egypt and Syria did not pass to successor rulers at the same moment.
zh: 阿尤布宫廷分布于有亲缘关系的多位统治者。
埃及与叙利亚并非同时进入继承政权。

title.en: Purépecha state: a western rival to the Mexica
title.zh: 普雷佩查国家：墨西加西部的竞争者

summary.en:
The state conventionally called Tarascan, also associated with Purépecha peoples, developed in western Mexico. Tzintzuntzan became its major capital. It was a contemporary of the Mexica Triple Alliance, not a province of that empire.

Research on ceramics, metallurgy and production examines how political authority coordinated regional resources without assuming that every workshop was directly managed by the court. This provides a comparison with Andean and central Mexican states. Spanish conquest changed its political institutions, while Purépecha communities and languages continued. The end of the state is therefore not an endpoint for the people.
summary.zh:
通常称为塔拉斯坎、并与普雷佩查民族相关的国家，在墨西哥西部发展。钦聪灿成为重要首都。它与墨西加三方同盟同时存在，而不是那个帝国的一个省。

关于陶器、冶金和生产的研究，考察政治权威如何协调区域资源，同时不假定所有工坊都由王室直接管理。这为比较安第斯和墨西哥中部国家提供材料。西班牙征服改变了政治机构，但普雷佩查社区和语言继续存在。因此国家终结不是人民历史的终点。

dateNote.en: 1250–1532 follows the Met’s broad Tarascan-state chronology. Archaeological studies may date a more centralized imperial phase later. Tzintzuntzan is a representative capital, not a fixed boundary for the whole interval.
dateNote.zh: 1250—1532年采用大都会博物馆宽泛的塔拉斯坎国家分期。考古研究可能把中央集权帝国阶段定得更晚。钦聪灿为代表性首都，不是整个时段的固定疆界。

en: The Purépecha state was a rival of the Mexica.
Its political end does not mean the disappearance of Purépecha communities.
zh: 普雷佩查国家是墨西加的竞争者。
政治终结不表示普雷佩查社区消失。

title.en: Mixtec kingdoms: alliances recorded in painted books
title.zh: 米斯特克诸国：彩绘书记录的联盟

location.label: Tilantongo region; representative Mixtec royal center

summary.en:
Mixtec history was organized around several interacting kingdoms, with rulers forming alliances through marriage, ritual and warfare. Painted screenfold books recorded genealogies, places and political acts. They preserve a way of making historical authority visible that differs from an alphabetical chronicle.

Archaeologists combine these manuscripts with settlement surveys to investigate the relationships among named places and ruling families. The surviving books often present elite perspectives, not a complete census of ordinary lives. The timeline therefore labels a sequence of kingdoms rather than inventing one unified Mixtec empire.
summary.zh:
米斯特克历史围绕多个互相联系的王国展开，统治者通过婚姻、仪式与战争结成关系。彩绘折叠书记录谱系、地点和政治行为，保存一种不同于字母文字编年史的历史权威表达方式。

考古学家把这些写本与聚落调查结合，研究地名和统治家族之间的关系。现存书籍往往表达精英视角，并非普通生活的完整清单。因此时间线标记的是诸王国序列，而不是虚构一个统一米斯特克帝国。

dateNote.en: Approximate 1000–1521 represents Postclassic kingdoms before Spanish conquest, following the Met. Individual kingdoms began and changed at different dates; 1521 is a regional conquest-period convention, not the end of all Indigenous authority.
dateNote.zh: 约1000—1521年依据大都会博物馆，代表西班牙征服前后古典期诸国。各王国起源与变化时间不同；1521年是区域征服时期分期，不是全部原住民主权的统一终点。

en: Several kingdoms interacted; there was no single unified Mixtec state here.
Painted books encode political relationships and elite historical claims.
zh: 多个王国互相联系，本条不设单一统一帝国。
彩绘书编码政治关系和精英历史主张。

title.en: Toltec Tula: a capital and its contested wider reach
title.zh: 托尔特克图拉：都城与有待讨论的外部影响

summary.en:
Tula became a major urban and political center in central Mexico during the early Postclassic period. Its monumental core and extensive residential areas reveal a city whose history extends beyond the celebrated warrior sculptures. Archaeological work continues to investigate neighborhoods, production and everyday activity.

Claims about Toltec power across Mesoamerica require care: shared imagery does not automatically prove direct rule from Tula. This entry uses the city’s Tollan phase as a political-center interval and leaves the extent of a wider empire unresolved. Comparing it with Teotihuacan and the later Mexica highlights both changing capitals and later claims about prestigious predecessors.
summary.zh:
早期后古典期，图拉成为墨西哥中部的重要城市与政治中心。纪念性核心和广阔居住区表明，这座城市的历史远不止著名武士雕像。考古工作继续研究社区、生产和日常活动。

关于托尔特克权力遍及中美洲的主张需要谨慎：共享图像不自动证明图拉直接统治。本条采用城市托兰阶段作为政治中心时段，并不确定一个更大帝国的范围。与特奥蒂瓦坎及后来的墨西加比较，可以观察都城变化和后人对著名前驱的追认。

dateNote.en: Approximate 900–1150 is INAH’s Tollan urban phase, not a securely bounded empire lifespan. The state is represented by its documented capital; broader political reach remains disputed.
dateNote.zh: 约900—1150年采用墨西哥国家人类学与历史研究所的托兰城市阶段，不是疆域已知帝国的确切寿命。这里以有文献考古依据的都城代表政权，更广范围仍有争议。

en: Urban archaeological evidence is stronger than claims of a precisely bounded empire.
Shared styles do not by themselves prove political control.
zh: 城市考古证据强于精确帝国疆界主张。
共享风格本身不证明政治控制。

title.en: Champa: coastal courts and sacred centers
title.zh: 占婆诸国：沿海宫廷与宗教中心

location.label: My Son sanctuary; representative early Cham sacred center

summary.en:
Cham polities developed along the coast of what is now central and southern Vietnam. My Son preserves a long sequence of Hindu tower temples that connected rulers, sacred geography and skilled brick construction. Religious ideas from South Asia were adapted within local societies rather than copied into an empty landscape.

The history includes several centers and shifting political relationships, so “Champa” should not imply a unified state with one capital for its entire existence. The loss of northern centers did not end every Cham polity. Later communities also sustained religious and cultural traditions after the end of the last autonomous principality.
summary.zh:
占族政权沿今越南中南部海岸发展。美山保存长期营建的印度教塔庙序列，将君主、神圣地理与砖构技艺联系起来。来自南亚的宗教观念在本地社会中被改造，并非复制到一片空白土地。

这段历史涉及多个中心和变化的政治关系，因此“占婆”不应表示整个存在期间都由同一首都控制的统一国家。北部中心失落，并未终结每一个占族政权。最后一个自治公国结束之后，社区仍延续宗教与文化传统。

dateNote.en: 192–1832 is a broad sequence from the traditionally recorded first polity to the annexation of Panduranga. My Son’s main surviving building sequence is fourth–thirteenth century; it was not the capital for this entire interval. This is a plural polity lineage, not one unchanged state.
dateNote.zh: 192—1832年为从传统记载的早期政权至潘郎被兼并的宽泛序列。美山主要现存建筑属于4—13世纪，并非整个时段的都城。本条表示多个政权的延续，不是一个不变国家。

en: Champa was a sequence of regional centers and rulers.
My Son’s monument dates are shorter than the broader political sequence.
zh: 占婆由多个区域中心与统治者构成。
美山建筑年代短于更广的政治序列。

title.en: Konbaung: royal expansion and colonial conquest
title.zh: 贡榜王朝：王室扩张与殖民征服

summary.en:
The Konbaung dynasty emerged in central Myanmar in 1752 and expanded across much of the region. Its rulers moved their capitals over time; Mandalay became the final royal center. Royal diplomacy, Buddhist patronage and warfare linked the court to neighbors and distant powers.

Expansion brought the kingdom into conflict with British-ruled India. Three Anglo-Burmese wars progressively removed territory and ended the monarchy in 1885. Royal chronicles and administrative orders provide evidence for this period, but each was produced for particular purposes. The end of the dynasty must be separated from the much longer histories of Myanmar’s diverse communities.
summary.zh:
贡榜王朝于1752年兴起于今缅甸中部，并向区域多处扩张。统治者曾多次迁都，曼德勒成为最后的王室中心。外交、佛教资助与战争，把宫廷连接到邻国和远方势力。

扩张使王国与英国统治的印度发生冲突。三次英缅战争逐步夺去领土，并于1885年终结君主制。王室编年史和行政命令为该时期提供证据，但各类文书都有特定制作目的。王朝终点需要与缅甸多元社区更长久的历史区分。

dateNote.en: 1752–1885 is the conventional dynastic interval. Mandalay was only the final capital, not the dynasty’s capital from its beginning. The endpoint marks overthrow of the monarchy, not an end to resistance or community histories.
dateNote.zh: 1752—1885年为通行王朝时段。曼德勒只是末期首都，并非从创立之初即为都。终点标记君主制被推翻，不表示抵抗或社区历史结束。

sources.title: Burma to Myanmar: 1500 years of connection and isolation
sources.evidenceNote: Curatorial history identifies Konbaung foundation in 1752 and conflict with British expansion; full page fetch was blocked, indexed excerpt reviewed.

sources.title: Burmese Sources for the History of the Konbaung Period 1752–1885
sources.publisher: Ma Yi Yi / Journal of Southeast Asian History
sources.evidenceNote: Primary-source study defines the period and surveys Burmese historical records.

en: Capital changes occurred within the dynasty.
Colonial conquest proceeded through several wars, not one instantaneous transfer.
zh: 王朝期间曾迁移首都。
殖民征服经过多次战争，而非瞬间移交。

title.en: Kamakura: warrior government beside the imperial court
title.zh: 镰仓幕府：与天皇宫廷并存的武家政府

summary.en:
The Kamakura period brought a shift in political power toward provincial military families. Warrior government operated from Kamakura while the imperial court continued in Kyoto. This coexistence is more useful than imagining a clean replacement of every earlier institution.

New patrons supported Buddhist sculpture, narrative painting and religious movements. Connections with China also shaped learning and artistic production. The fall of the Kamakura government in 1333 began another contested political transition. Its institutional end should not be confused with the end of warrior influence or the disappearance of the imperial court.
summary.zh:
镰仓时期，政治权力向地方军事家族转移。武家政府以镰仓为中心运作，天皇宫廷则继续存在于京都。理解这种并存，比想象此前所有机构被彻底替代更有帮助。

新的资助者支持佛教雕塑、叙事绘画和宗教运动。与中国的联系也塑造学问和艺术生产。1333年镰仓政府倒台，开启另一段充满竞争的政治过渡。机构终结不能等同于武家影响消失，也不表示天皇宫廷不再存在。

dateNote.en: 1185–1333 follows the political-period convention used by Columbia; formal shogunal appointment occurred in 1192. The Met combines Kamakura and Nanbokucho in a longer 1185–1392 art-history essay. Kamakura is the government point, not the imperial capital.
dateNote.zh: 1185—1333年采用哥伦比亚大学的政治时期分期；正式征夷大将军任命在1192年。大都会文章将镰仓与南北朝合为1185—1392年的艺术史阶段。点位为幕府政府，不是天皇都城。

sources.title: Kamakura Period (1185–1333)
sources.evidenceNote: Distinguishes warrior governments and political-period dates.

sources.title: Kamakura and Nanbokucho Periods
sources.evidenceNote: Describes political shift, new patrons and religious/artistic changes.

en: The imperial court continued alongside warrior government.
1185 and the 1192 appointment represent different milestones.
zh: 天皇宫廷与武家政府并存。
1185年与1192年任命代表不同里程碑。

title.en: Ashikaga / Muromachi: authority amid competing powers
title.zh: 足利／室町幕府：竞争势力之间的权威

summary.en:
Ashikaga warrior government established its center in Kyoto during a struggle over imperial legitimacy. Its authority depended on relationships with regional military lords, temples and the court. The reunification of rival imperial lines in 1392 did not eliminate later conflict.

Commercial and urban networks expanded while Zen institutions and renewed contacts with China shaped painting, gardens and other arts. Political fragmentation therefore coexisted with cultural innovation. The removal of the last Ashikaga shogun in 1573 marks the institutional endpoint used here, before the later Tokugawa government consolidated a different order.
summary.zh:
足利武家政府在争夺天皇正统性的斗争中，以京都为中心建立。其权威依赖与地方武将、寺院和宫廷的关系。1392年对立皇统合一，并未消除后来的冲突。

商业与城市网络扩展，禅宗机构及重新加强的对华联系也塑造绘画、园林等艺术。政治分裂因而能够与文化创新并存。本条以1573年最后一位足利将军被逐为机构终点，随后德川政府才整合出另一种秩序。

dateNote.en: 1336–1573 represents Ashikaga political government, with the shogunal appointment in 1338. Art histories may start Muromachi in 1392 after the divided imperial courts. Those are different periodization choices, not contradictory event dates.
dateNote.zh: 1336—1573年表示足利政治政府，正式将军任命在1338年。艺术史有时在南北皇统合一的1392年开始室町时期。这是不同分期选择，不是事件日期互相矛盾。

sources.title: Muromachi Period (1392–1573)
sources.evidenceNote: Explains economic networks, China contacts and artistic innovation despite political upheaval.

sources.title: Japan’s medieval warrior governments
sources.evidenceNote: Political teaching chronology distinguishes Kamakura and Muromachi governments.

en: A political government and an art period can have different start dates.
Fragmentation did not halt commercial or artistic change.
zh: 政治政府与艺术时期可能采用不同起点。
分裂没有阻止商业与艺术变化。

title.en: United States: a republic changed by expansion and conflict
title.zh: 美国：在扩张与冲突中变化的共和国

location.label: Washington, D.C.; later federal capital, representative point

summary.en:
Thirteen colonies declared independence in 1776, but creating a durable federal government required further negotiation. The Constitution replaced the Articles of Confederation framework, and amendments subsequently changed the written political order. Declaration, recognition and constitutional government are separate milestones.

The country’s continuing name should not imply unchanged territory, citizenship or political participation. Expansion displaced Indigenous peoples; slavery, civil war and civil-rights struggles reshaped the republic. This overview connects those separate entries so the timeline can show the country’s continuing political story without displaying every event as a competing state.
summary.zh:
十三个殖民地于1776年宣布独立，但建立持久联邦政府仍需进一步协商。宪法取代《邦联条例》框架，后续修正案不断改变成文政治秩序。独立宣言、外部承认与宪政政府是不同里程碑。

国名延续并不意味着领土、公民身份或政治参与始终不变。扩张驱逐原住民，奴隶制、内战与民权斗争重塑共和国。本概览把这些独立条目连接起来，让时间线呈现国家延续，而不必把每件事件都画成一个竞争政权。

dateNote.en: 1776 begins with the declaration rather than British recognition in 1783 or the federal Constitution’s operation in 1789. 2026 is the atlas cutoff for an ongoing country. Washington was not the capital throughout the interval; no historical borders are inferred from this point.
dateNote.zh: 1776年起于独立宣言，而非1783年英国承认或1789年联邦宪法运作。2026年为仍存国家的地图截止点。华盛顿并非全时段首都；点位不推定历史疆界。

title.en: Canada: federation, expansion and constitutional change
title.zh: 加拿大：联邦、扩展与宪制变化

summary.en:
Confederation joined colonies in a federal state in 1867. The new Dominion initially contained four provinces, and its territory expanded as other provinces and territories entered or were created. The founding date is therefore not the date at which today’s map was completed.

Canada’s constitutional development continued through growing autonomy and the 1982 constitutional settlement. That state history intersects with much older Indigenous societies, treaties and contested land relationships. Linking Confederation with Niagara diplomacy and Nunavut helps learners distinguish the federation’s institutions from the histories of all peoples living within its changing claimed territory.
summary.zh:
1867年的联邦成立把殖民地结合为一个联邦国家。新自治领最初有四个省，后随其他省区加入或设立而扩展。建国日期因此不是今天地图全部完成的日期。

加拿大宪制发展继续经历自治权增长与1982年的宪制安排。这一国家史与更古老的原住民社会、条约及有争议的土地关系交织。将联邦成立与尼亚加拉外交和努纳武特相连，有助于区分联邦机构史与变化领土主张内所有人民的历史。

dateNote.en: 1867 starts the federation, not full independence achieved at a single moment. 2026 is an atlas cutoff for an ongoing country. The interval does not project current territory backward or erase pre-Confederation histories.
dateNote.zh: 1867年标记联邦成立，不表示完全独立在某个瞬间完成。2026年为仍存国家的地图截止点。该时段不把当代领土倒投过去，也不抹去联邦成立前的历史。

en: The federation grew after 1867.
Federal state history is one layer of a much older inhabited landscape.
zh: 联邦在1867年后继续扩展。
联邦国家史只是更古老居住景观的一层。

title.en: India: independence, republic and a federal constitution
title.zh: 印度：独立、共和国与联邦宪法

location.label: New Delhi; representative national government center

summary.en:
Independent India emerged in 1947 amid Partition, migration and violence. Independence did not immediately create the republican constitutional order: the Constitution was adopted in 1949 and came into force on 26 January 1950. Those events established different milestones in a single continuing state history.

The constitution organized parliamentary government, rights and a federal relationship among institutions and regions. Later amendments and political struggles changed that framework. The continuing country interval connects the Salt March, Partition and the republic without implying that colonial administration, the transitional dominion and the republic were the same regime.
summary.zh:
1947年，印度在分治、迁徙与暴力中独立。独立并未立刻产生共和宪制：宪法于1949年通过，1950年1月26日生效。这些事件是同一持续国家史中不同的里程碑。

宪法组织议会政府、权利以及机构和地区之间的联邦关系。后续修正与政治斗争继续改变框架。国家延续条目连接盐行、分治与共和国，同时不把殖民行政、过渡自治领和共和国当成同一政体。

dateNote.en: 1947 is independence; 1950 begins the republic. 2026 is the atlas cutoff for an ongoing country. This interval does not imply that current internal or external boundaries existed throughout.
dateNote.zh: 1947年为独立，1950年为共和起点。2026年是仍存国家的地图截止点。这一时段不意味着今天的内外边界始终存在。

en: Independence and republican government have different starting dates.
A continuing country can pass through constitutional change.
zh: 独立与共和政府具有不同起点。
持续存在的国家能够经历宪制变化。

title.en: Ghana: independence and successive republics
title.zh: 加纳：独立与历届共和国

summary.en:
Ghana became independent in 1957 with a Westminster-style constitutional framework. It became a republic in 1960. Parliamentary institutions then experienced interruption, military government and repeated constitutional reconstruction rather than a single unchanging postcolonial regime.

The return to constitutional rule in 1993 belongs to that longer sequence. A country-level timeline can retain Ghana’s continuity while allowing learners to open these institutional transitions as events. The name also recalls the much earlier West African Ghana / Wagadu empire, but the modern state should not be confused with the same territory or uninterrupted political authority.
summary.zh:
加纳于1957年在西敏式宪制框架下独立，1960年成为共和国。其议会机构后来经历中断、军政府与多次宪制重建，并非一个始终不变的后殖民政体。

1993年恢复宪政属于这条更长序列。国家层级时间线可以保留加纳的连续性，同时让学习者打开制度更替事件。国名也呼应更早的西非加纳／瓦加杜帝国，但现代国家不能被等同于相同领土或未经中断的政治权威。

dateNote.en: 1957 begins independent statehood; 1960 is the republican transition. 2026 is the atlas cutoff for an ongoing country. Regime changes within this interval are explicitly not smoothed into one constitutional system.
dateNote.zh: 1957年为独立国家起点，1960年为共和转型。2026年是仍存国家的地图截止点。其间政体变化并未被压平为同一种宪制。

en: Modern Ghana is distinct from the medieval Ghana / Wagadu empire.
Country continuity does not imply uninterrupted parliamentary government.
zh: 现代加纳不同于中世纪加纳／瓦加杜帝国。
国家延续不等于议会政府从未中断。

title.en: Brazil: from independent empire to changing republics
title.zh: 巴西：从独立帝国到变化的共和国

location.label: Brasília; later federal capital, representative point

summary.en:
Brazil’s independence in 1822 produced an empire rather than a republic. A constituent assembly met the following year, and the 1824 constitution organized the monarchy’s political institutions. The republic proclaimed in 1889 created another constitutional sequence.

Later assemblies, interruptions and new constitutions changed how the state operated. Brasília’s inauguration in 1960 also moved the federal center away from Rio de Janeiro. This continuous country entry links independence, abolition, republican change and the new capital while keeping their dates distinct. Continuity of the country’s name is not evidence that its regime or citizenship remained constant.
summary.zh:
1822年巴西独立产生的是帝国，而不是共和国。次年制宪会议召开，1824年宪法组织君主制政治机构。1889年宣布共和国，又开启另一条宪制序列。

后来议会、中断与新宪法改变国家运作。1960年巴西利亚启用，也使联邦中心离开里约热内卢。本持续国家条目连接独立、废奴、共和更替和新首都，同时保留各自日期。国名连续并不证明政体或公民身份始终相同。

dateNote.en: 1822 begins independence, not republican government. The empire ended in 1889. 2026 is the atlas cutoff for an ongoing country. Brasília is only the later capital; the point does not project it into the nineteenth century.
dateNote.zh: 1822年标记独立，而非共和政府开始。帝国于1889年终结。2026年为仍存国家的地图截止点。巴西利亚只是后来的首都，点位不把它倒投到19世纪。

title.en: Soviet Union: a union state with a definite endpoint
title.zh: 苏联：具有明确终点的联盟国家

summary.en:
The Soviet Union was formally established in 1922 after revolution and civil war in the former Russian Empire. It was a union of republics, with Russia the largest constituent, rather than simply another name for a Russian nation-state. Its political system and union territory changed over the following decades.

Repression, war, reconstruction and Cold War rivalry formed parts of its history. The crises of the late 1980s and 1991 ended the union and produced independent successor states. This timeline bar must stop in 1991: carrying it into later years would erase the very political transformation that the atlas is intended to explain.
summary.zh:
俄国革命和内战之后，苏联于1922年正式建立。它是共和国联盟，俄罗斯是最大成员，不能简单看作俄罗斯民族国家的另一个名称。此后数十年，其政治体制和联盟领土均发生变化。

镇压、战争、重建和冷战竞争都属于其历史。20世纪80年代末及1991年的危机终结联盟，产生独立继承国家。该时间条必须止于1991年：若延伸到后世，就会抹去地图本应解释的政治转变。

dateNote.en: 1922–1991 is the union state’s lifespan, distinct from the 1917 revolutions and from the later Russian Federation. The bar is annual: dissolution occurred in December 1991. Moscow is a government reference, not a territorial outline.
dateNote.zh: 1922—1991年为联盟国家存在时期，不同于1917年革命或其后的俄罗斯联邦。时间条以年为单位，解体发生于1991年12月。莫斯科是政府参照，不表示领土轮廓。

title.en: Japan since 1947: a new constitutional order
title.zh: 1947年以来的日本：新的宪制秩序

summary.en:
Japan’s postwar Constitution came into force in 1947 after debate and drafting under Allied occupation. It replaced the Meiji constitutional framework and changed the stated basis of sovereignty and the emperor’s constitutional position. This is a new constitutional period within Japan’s much longer history, not the founding of Japanese society.

Drafts, committee papers and correspondence show that the settlement developed through several stages and participants. A timeline that treats 1868 or 1947 as the start of all Japanese history would obscure earlier courts and warrior governments. The shared sequence instead lets learners compare institutional change across periods.
summary.zh:
战后日本宪法经盟军占领时期的讨论与起草，于1947年生效。它取代明治宪制框架，并改变主权的明文基础及天皇的宪法地位。这是日本更长历史中的新宪制时期，而不是日本社会的创立。

草案、委员会文件与往来文书表明，这一安排经过多个阶段和参与者。如果时间线把1868年或1947年当作全部日本历史的开端，就会遮蔽更早宫廷和武家政府。共享序列使学习者能够跨时期比较制度变化。

dateNote.en: 1947 begins the postwar constitutional period, not Japan as a country. 2026 is the atlas cutoff. The country had an earlier imperial constitution and earlier political institutions; this row deliberately names its narrower constitutional scope.
dateNote.zh: 1947年为战后宪制时期起点，不是日本国家起点。2026年为地图截止点。此前已有帝国宪法及更早政治机构，本行明确采用较窄的宪制范围。
